title: Carrier Point Destination
description: A parcel locker or staffed pickup point operated by a carrier network, not by the Business. The point is identified by the point key (`network`, `country`, `point_id`); the destination `id` is used for selection.

type.description: Destination type discriminator. Optional in requests under a `carrier_pickup` method, where it defaults to `carrier_point`.

id.description: Destination identifier used by `selected_destination_id`. A Platform that writes a point and selects it MUST set this to the value it puts in `selected_destination_id`. In responses, the ID the Business recognizes for this point within the method.

network.description: Carrier network that operates the point and whose point directory applies. See the well-known values in the Carrier Pickup specification. This is the operating network, not a broker, a buyer-facing brand or the host site. In requests, required unless the Platform sends `broker` only.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the point. Part of the point key: networks operate in several countries and do not guarantee point IDs unique across them. Never inferred from `point_id`. In requests, required with `network` and `point_id`.

point_id.description: Point identifier as issued by `network`, unique within (`network`, `country`). Opaque: compared as an exact, case-sensitive string, leading zeros preserved, never parsed. Never a broker's identifier. In requests, required unless the Platform sends `broker` only.

broker.description: Aggregator or broker through which the point was selected, with the broker's own identifier for the point. A Platform that knows only the broker's identifier sends `broker` without the point key, and the Business resolves it into the point key.

point_id.description: The broker's own identifier for the point. Opaque.

recipient.description: The person who collects the parcel, when the method needs recipient data (see `recipient_requirements` on the selected option). May differ from the purchaser, for example for a gift or a company purchase. Contains only the fields the selected option requires.

carrier_account_id.description: Recipient's customer number with the network, where the network requires one to deliver to its points (for example a locker network that delivers only to registered customers). Opaque.

point_type.description: Kind of point. Well-known values: `locker` (automated parcel locker, collected with a code), `staffed` (counter at a host or network branch, handed over by staff). Businesses MAY use additional values.

name.description: Buyer-facing name of the point. Plain text, no markup or links.

address.description: Postal address of the point, with at least `address_locality` and `address_country`. It is the point's address, not the Buyer's.

description.description: How to find the point when the address alone is not enough (e.g. 'Car park behind the station, next to the ticket office'). Plain text, no markup or links.

host.description: Physical site that houses the point, such as a shop or a fuel station. One site can host points of several networks; each is a separate destination with its own point key and terms. Typically known only to brokers; Businesses that integrate networks directly omit it.

id.description: Business-scoped identifier of the site, equal across the destinations at the same site within one response. Opaque; not a cross-Business identifier.

name.description: Buyer-facing name of the site. Plain text, no markup or links.

pickup_period.description: Holding period at this point when it differs from the period of the selected option (for example a locker at a site with limited opening hours).

limits.description: Parcel limits of this point, for display. Eligibility is decided by the Business and reported through `available` and `unavailable_reasons`.

max_dimensions.description: Maximum parcel dimensions in one length unit, largest first. Three values describe a box: a parcel fits when each of its dimensions, also sorted largest first, is at most the value at the same position. One value is the maximum length of the longest side.

available.description: Whether the Business can deliver the method's line items to this point, as of the response. Absent means not evaluated. The Business MUST set it on the selected destination.

unavailable_reasons.description: Machine-readable reasons why the point cannot be used. Present if and only if `available` is `false`.

point_key.title: Carrier Point Key
point_key.description: Identifies a carrier point independently of any Checkout.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the point.

pickup_period.title: Pickup Period
pickup_period.description: How long the network holds a parcel at the point, as advertised before purchase. Informational: the deadline for a given parcel is the `pickup_by` the Business reports on its deposit event.

starts.description: Event the period counts from. Well-known values: `deposit` (the parcel is placed at the point), `notification` (the Buyer is notified that the parcel is ready). Absent means not stated.

counting.description: How days in `duration` are counted. Well-known values: `calendar_days`, `business_days` (as the network defines them). Absent means calendar time.

code.description: Reason code. Well-known values: `exceeds_size_limit`, `exceeds_weight_limit`, `item_not_eligible` (an item the network does not accept at points, independent of size), `point_full`, `point_closed` (temporarily out of service), `point_not_found` (unknown to or removed from the network directory), `network_not_supported`, `country_not_supported`, `option_mismatch` (the point does not belong to the network of the selected option), `point_type_not_supported`. Businesses MAY use additional values.

line_item_ids.description: Line items that cause this reason, when it is item-specific.

content.description: Buyer-facing explanation. Plain text, no markup or links.
